name: Tom Becker
message: Hello, I'll explain our situation in detail because it's a bit complicated. We are a five-person consulting firm and every week we receive somewhere between forty and sixty enquiries through our website contact form, LinkedIn messages, and referrals from existing clients. At the moment my assistant copies each enquiry into a spreadsheet by hand, then forwards it to whichever consultant she thinks is the right fit, and that consultant is supposed to reply within one working day. In practice this falls apart all the time. Some enquiries get forwarded to the wrong person, some sit in someone's inbox for three or four days, and a few are never answered at all, which is embarrassing when it's a referral from a client we care about. We have also noticed that the replies are very inconsistent: one consultant writes a long, detailed email with pricing, another writes two lines asking for a call. We would like every new enquiry to get a quick, friendly, consistent first reply, to be logged automatically, and ideally to be routed to the right consultant based on the topic. We use Google Workspace and HubSpot's free plan. Is this the kind of thing you can build, roughly how long would it take, and what would you need from us to get started? Thanks in advance.
